notes.title: Friday News!
notes.notes: [p]Hello! ːsteamhappyː[/p][p][/p][p][b]This week, we're continuing our deep dive into reworking and improving the physics systems[/b] for vehicles. While there aren’t many visuals to share—most of the progress is happening behind the scenes with numbers, formulas, and fine-tuning—there’s exciting stuff underway.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Traction Overhaul[/b] A major focus has been enhancing how tracks perform over rough terrain. We’re also working toward a system where different track and wheel types will have varying levels of traction based on their design and intended use. This should lead to more realistic and strategic vehicle handling.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Effect Optimization[/b] We’ve made improvements to several visual effects, including optimizing the smoke generated during production. These tweaks should help with performance and improved visuals.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Periodic Table Clarification[/b] As for the upcoming Periodic Table feature: only elements that are currently obtainable in-game will be unlockable. Items like gases or other substances that aren’t accessible through gameplay won’t be included at launch. However, anything that can be discovered or produced within the game will be available to unlock![/p][p][/p][p][b]While we don’t have a ETA, the finish line is clearly in sight for the update. notes.notes:
Hello!

This week, we have kept fixing and working on the [b]conveyors, sorters, production units, UI, and power systems[/b] to make sure it all works as intended and just make sure it all makes sense.

*Brand new building system that is alot more user friendly
